sources.fact: LBBD90/ZO Cambridge House is 0.26ha, 117 net dwellings and planning-permission-status not-permissioned.
ZO supplies POINT (0.079574 51.538747) and blank geometry; the point is not a site red-line or legal title boundary.
Ownership-status is not-owned-by-a-public-authority; this does not identify the legal owner or title number.
The Brownfield site-address field is Cambridge House without a full street address, so name-only application matching is unsafe.

A 2015 LBBD Planning Committee record lists application 15/00288/FUL at Cambridge House, 3-9 Cambridge Road, Barking for first-floor office-to-residential conversion; it was refused under delegated powers.
The 2015 case concerned creation of four flats on the first floor and is historical; it is not treated as a current permission for the 117-home ZO allocation.
The 2019 Crown House and Linton Road Car Park committee minutes record objections from tenants/applicants at Cambridge House, confirming local adjacency/context but not a ZO redevelopment permission.
18/01972/FUL is a separate Crown House/Linton Road scheme for 396 homes; its permission cannot be transferred to Cambridge House.
LBBD Local Plan 2037 was adopted 18 September 2024; allocation status remains policy evidence rather than planning permission.
LBBD states all Brownfield Register sites require planning permission.
Planning Data contains another CAMBRIDGE HOUSE listed-building entity at a different coordinate outside Barking, demonstrating name collision risk.
Planning Data contains a second unrelated CAMBRIDGE HOUSE listed-building entity at another location, reinforcing that name alone cannot bind a planning/title record.

examples.result: ZO remains not-permissioned at 117 net dwellings.
The 2015 four-flat Cambridge House application is retained as historical evidence, not current ZO permission.
Crown House 18/01972/FUL is an adjacent separate case and is never transferred to ZO.
Cambridge House name collisions across official datasets block name-only matching.
The ZO point is not converted into a site polygon.
Non-public ownership status is not owner/title identification.
117 is allocation/Brownfield capacity, not consented units.
Promotion remains zero until exact current ZO application/address/title relation and statutory overlays are verified.
